{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Esselian]] [[Cassander Tadrin]] owned a '''conglomerate''' a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He sold the conglomerate's holdings to fund a colonization effort in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]], transplanting himself and tens of thousands of loyal employees and their families to newly-discovered [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that would become known as the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]].
